definitions.explanation: Ground that is frozen, either temporarily in winter or permanently in cold regions. Often used in the compound 永久凍土 (permafrost).

examples.japanese: ⟦{永久|えいきゅう}→永久：01875_eikyuu⟧{凍土|とうど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溶|と}けている→溶ける：02302_tokeru⟧。
⟦{北極|ほっきょく}→北極：16689_hokkyoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広大|こうだい}→広大：11328_koudai⟧な{凍土|とうど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Vast stretches of frozen ground spread across the Arctic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}{温暖化|おんだんか}→地球温暖化：18873_chikyuuondanka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{永久|えいきゅう}→永久：01875_eikyuu⟧{凍土|とうど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: Due to global warming, permafrost is rapidly decreasing.

notes:
{凍土|とうど} refers to ground or soil that is frozen, whether seasonally or permanently. In everyday Japanese, it most often appears in the compound ⟦{永久|えいきゅう}→永久：01875_eikyuu⟧{凍土|とうど} (permafrost), particularly in discussions of climate change and Arctic environments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {凍土|とうど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溶|と}ける→溶ける：02302_tokeru⟧ (frozen ground melts)
- {凍土|とうど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧ (frozen ground extends)
- {凍土|とうど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧ (frozen ground decreases)
- {凍土|とうど}⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧ (frozen ground zone)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{永久|えいきゅう}→永久：01875_eikyuu⟧{凍土|とうど} (permafrost — permanently frozen ground)
- {凍土|とうど}{壁|へき} (frozen soil wall — used in construction to block groundwater)

USAGE:
- Most commonly encountered in the compound ⟦{永久|えいきゅう}→永久：01875_eikyuu⟧{凍土|とうど}
- Used in geography, environmental science, and climate change discussions
- The kanji {凍|とう} means "freeze" and {土|ど} means "earth/soil"
